features.title: What you can create
features.lead: Write the way you'd talk to a person. ANZAR takes care of the rest.

items.title: Your apps and websites
items.text: Explain your project. ANZAR writes the code, tests it and shows you the result. You refine it just by talking.
items.example: “Make me an online shop for my fabrics, with orders over WhatsApp.”

items.title: Your documents
items.text: Split a PDF, turn a file into Word or Excel, tidy up a spreadsheet. Your original stays untouched.
items.example: “Split this PDF in two and turn the second half into a Word document.”

items.title: Your visuals and videos
items.text: Posters, social media posts and animated videos with music, ready to share.
items.example: “Make a 20-second video announcing my shop's grand opening.”

items.title: Work that gets done while you're away
items.text: Hand off a task or schedule it for later. ANZAR works on its own and waits for your approval.
items.example: “Every Monday morning, check my website and fix anything that's broken.”

items.title: Pay only for what you use
items.text: No subscription. Top up in your currency with mobile money or a card, and every request shows what it costs.

items.title: You stay in control
items.text: You decide what ANZAR can do on its own and what it has to ask about first. After every task, you see exactly what changed.

items.title: Your files stay with you
items.text: ANZAR works on your computer. Only the parts needed for your request are sent to the AI.

pricing.title: Pay in your currency.
pricing.text: Top up whenever you want, starting with a small amount. Your credits never expire.
pricing.currencies: CFA franc, naira, cedi, shilling, rand, dirham, euro, dollar…

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Describe what you want in your own words, and ANZAR does the work and shows you the result. If you already code, it works right inside your projects.

items.q: Which computers does ANZAR run on?
items.a: Macs with Apple silicon (M1 and later) and PCs running Windows 10 or 11. You'll need an internet connection.
From inside the app, with mobile money or a bank card, in your own currency. Your credits are added as soon as the payment is confirmed.
Yes. Your files stay on your computer. To answer a request, only the relevant parts are sent to the AI.
Yours: it replies in whatever language you write to it in. The app's menus are in French for now.

help.q: macOS says it can't verify ANZAR
help.a: That's expected during the beta. Open System Settings, then Privacy & Security, scroll down to the message about ANZAR and click “Open Anyway”. On older versions of macOS, right-click ANZAR in Applications and choose “Open”. You only need to do this once.
That's a common message for new apps. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.

help.q: How do I know which chip my Mac has?
help.a: Open the Apple menu and choose “About This Mac”. If you see “Chip Apple M1” (or M2, M3…), ANZAR is made for your Mac.

help.q: My Mac has an Intel processor
help.a: The version for Intel Macs isn't available yet. In the meantime, ANZAR runs on any PC with Windows 10 or 11.

p: ANZAR is a service published by IssalanHub, a company registered in Niamey, Niger. Contact: support@getanzar.com.
ANZAR is a desktop application that carries out creative tasks at your request: code, documents, visuals and videos. It relies on artificial intelligence models provided by third parties.
You sign in with your email address and a verification code. You are responsible for how your account is used. Let us know right away if you think someone has used it without your permission.

The service runs on prepaid credits, with no subscription. Pack prices are shown in the app, in your currency, before you pay. Each request uses credits based on the work done, and its cost is displayed.
Credits never expire. They cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred to another account.
Purchased credits are non-refundable, except in the case of a billing error or where the law requires otherwise. If you have a problem with a payment, write to support@getanzar.com.
You agree not to use ANZAR for illegal activities, to harm others, to create malicious software or to infringe anyone's rights. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.
What you create with ANZAR belongs to you. AI-generated results can contain mistakes, so review them before you rely on them, especially for professional use.
We do our best to keep the service available and reliable, but we cannot guarantee it at all times. Our liability is limited to the amount of credits purchased in the past twelve months.
We may update these terms. If we make a significant change, we'll let you know in the app or by email.
These terms are governed by the laws of Niger.
Your projects and files stay on your computer. We only collect what we need to run your account, your payments and the AI's answers. We do not sell your data.
Your email address, your balance, your top-up and credit usage history, and anything you ask ANZAR to remember. We also keep technical logs to keep the service secure.

To answer a request, ANZAR sends your message and the relevant parts of your files to our server, which passes them on to the AI model (DeepSeek). Our servers do not store the content of your conversations: it stays on your computer. If you turn on web search, your search queries go through a search provider.
Payments are processed by our payment providers (mobile money and bank card). We never see or store your card number.
This website uses no advertising and no tracking tools. It only stores your language choice in a cookie, if you switch languages.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data by writing to support@getanzar.com.
